content.json:
# Azure Automation — Runbook Monitoring

Job outcomes, durations, failures and error streams for one or more Automation Accounts.

> Requires a **Diagnostic setting** on the Automation Account sending the **JobLogs** and **JobStreams** categories to the Log Analytics workspace selected below.

parameters.name: RunbookName
parameters.label: Runbook
parameters.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| distinct RunbookName_s
| where isnotempty(RunbookName_s)
| order by RunbookName_s asc

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| where "*" in ({RunbookName}) or RunbookName_s in ({RunbookName})
| where ResultType in ("Completed", "Failed", "Stopped", "Suspended")
| summarize Jobs = dcount(JobId_g) by ResultType
| order by Jobs desc
content.title: Jobs by outcome

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| where "*" in ({RunbookName}) or RunbookName_s in ({RunbookName})
| where ResultType in ("Completed", "Failed", "Stopped", "Suspended")
| summarize Jobs = dcount(JobId_g) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), ResultType
content.title: Job outcomes over time

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| where "*" in ({RunbookName}) or RunbookName_s in ({RunbookName})
| where ResultType in ("Completed", "Failed")
| summarize Total = dcount(JobId_g), Failed = dcountif(JobId_g, ResultType == "Failed"), LastRun = max(TimeGenerated) by Runbook = RunbookName_s
| extend ['Failure %'] = round(todouble(Failed) * 100 / Total, 1)
| order by Failed desc, ['Failure %'] desc
content.title: Failure rate by runbook

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobStreams"
| where StreamType_s in ("Error", "Warning")
| where "*" in ({RunbookName}) or RunbookName_s in ({RunbookName})
| project TimeGenerated, Runbook = RunbookName_s, Stream = StreamType_s, JobId = JobId_g, Message = ResultDescription
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent error and warning streams

content.json:
## Duration and cost drivers

Automation bills on job runtime, so the slowest runbooks are usually the most expensive ones.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| where "*" in ({RunbookName}) or RunbookName_s in ({RunbookName})
| summarize
    Runbook   = any(RunbookName_s),
    StartTime = minif(TimeGenerated, ResultType == "Started"),
    EndTime   = maxif(TimeGenerated, ResultType in ("Completed", "Failed", "Stopped", "Suspended")),
    Outcome   = anyif(ResultType, ResultType in ("Completed", "Failed", "Stopped", "Suspended"))
    by JobId = JobId_g
| where isnotempty(StartTime) and isnotempty(EndTime)
| extend ['Duration (min)'] = round(datetime_diff('second', EndTime, StartTime) / 60.0, 2)
| project Runbook, JobId, Outcome, StartTime, ['Duration (min)']
| order by ['Duration (min)'] desc
| take 25
content.title: Longest running jobs

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs"
| where "*" in ({RunbookName}) or RunbookName_s in ({RunbookName})
| where ResultType in ("Completed", "Failed")
| extend Target = iff(isempty(column_ifexists("RunOn_s", "")), "Azure sandbox", column_ifexists("RunOn_s", ""))
| summarize Jobs = dcount(JobId_g) by Target, ResultType
content.title: Sandbox vs Hybrid Worker
